_description: Battle-tested ElevenLabs Sound Generation prompts for cinematic drone montages. Adjust scene specifics, keep style anchors.
_style_rules: Always end with 'cinematic ambient' or 'cinematic ambient minimal'
Specify count: 'one or two', 'two or three' — never 'many'
Specify POV: 'drone view', 'recorded from far distance'
Add 'no music' to prevent ElevenLabs adding music background
Add 'at moderate volume not silent' if subtle (else file is too quiet)
